limits.scope: FFHQ and ImageNet existing3 images each x Gaussian61/sigma3 and frozenMotion61 x two arms.
limits.baseline: Pinned DiffPIR main_ddpir.py sampling For AST executed unmodified. Native100 quadratic sequence, eta0, U1, learned_range, clip_denoisedTrue.
limits.parameters: Paper supplement Table3 NFE100/sigma_y=.05: FFHQ Gaussian(lambda7,zeta.3),Motion(7,.4);ImageNet Gaussian(8,.3),Motion(8,.7). No quality-based selection.
limits.noise: Physical[0,1] sigma=.05, equivalent model-coordinate sigma=.10. Native circular FFT convolution; NEW shared y per arm, not old A75/A77 zero-boundary y.
limits.insertion: q_clean=z_prox-m; d=H(q_clean), r=y-H(m) in[0,1]. Same noise_signal_shrink.select scales q_clean only. No 1/sqrt(alpha) factor because correction already in clean coordinates.
limits.preserved: Original rho_t/lambda spectral direction and zeta noise injection retained. Like prior projection, positive global guidance amplitude is canceled by gamma. No optimizer/input derivative or next-denoiser probe.
limits.output: Original x_0 derived from x is returned; the native last unused pred_xstart evaluation is retained and counted. No final-output replacement, clamp, extra sampling or GT selection.
limits.timing: Complete100 loop: y/operator/init/FFT/NN/sampling/CPU output sync and progress bookkeeping included; model load/probe/measurement generation/metrics/output writes separate.
limits.limits: Small reused development panel, local paper-parameter native-loop reference with shared fixed kernels, not author benchmark reproduction. Both model/dataset changes paired; no universal improvement or state-necessity claim.
